B0_IDENTITY.justification: Frozen source and testbank identities and the exact Transsub.for and Transorp.for member hashes are pinned before review.

AUTHORITATIVE_EQUATION_IDENTITY.justification: The candidate evaluates algebraically identical revision-53 Iflsol=4 coefficient functions with explicit analytic limits; no constitutive equation is replaced.

NUMERICAL_POLICY_AND_CONVERGENCE_EVIDENC.justification: The 4756-point Decimal oracle covers subnormal-scale cancellation, crossover neighborhoods and large positive x; maximum observed relative errors remain below 20u and below the predeclared 128u verification envelope.

SOURCE_COEFFICIENT_OWNERSHIP.justification: The qualified values are call-local analytical coefficients produced by Detcoef and derivative coefficients produced by Coefdc; no new persistent model state is introduced.

INITIALIZATION_AND_RESTART_SEMANTICS.justification: The candidate changes only evaluation of call-local coefficient functions and creates no initialized, checkpointed or restored state.

CONSERVATION.justification: NQ02 shows the coefficient correction is materially trajectory-active but does not uniformly improve the TCD-019 residual, preventing conservation improvement from masking the numerical decision; the same analytical coefficient equations introduce no new source or sink.

NON_INTERFERENCE.justification: No solver stopping rule, residual tolerance, state owner, restart contract, constitutive law, canonical register or production source is changed by NQ04.

EDGE_AND_BOUNDARY_CASE_COVERAGE.justification: The oracle includes x=0, both sides of the exact 0.25 crossover, values approaching -1 from above, subnormal-scale magnitudes and large positive values; outside-domain inputs are fail-closed.

HISTORICAL_UNCERTAINTY_ROUTE.justification: No qualified B2 is available; historical corrected behavior remains explicitly UNKNOWN_WITHOUT_B2 and the synthetic oracle is not promoted to B2.

NO_PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZATION.justification: NQ04 is qualification only. Production implementation, compiler-level FP binding and B4 remain unauthorized.

split_run_or_restart_evidence.justification: The numerical policy has no persistent state and therefore no split-run or restart semantic surface.

tier_c_enhanced.exact_comparison_policy: Compare binary64 F/G/H against high-precision Decimal references on the frozen deterministic 4756-point set with the predeclared 128u relative equation-evaluation envelope; separately require the natural NQ02 B2 control to equal its pinned rounded binary64 value.

residual_uncertainty: Historical revision-53 corrected behavior remains UNKNOWN_WITHOUT_B2.
NQ04 does not qualify TCD-019 solver or fallback semantics, Coefdt, or other Iflsol branches.
Future production binding must separately freeze or qualify compiler reassociation, contraction and intrinsic behavior.
